outcome.Summary: Extended the config package: added `Timeout time.Duration` (env APP_TIMEOUT via time.ParseDuration, default 30s in Defaults) and `Tags []string` (env APP_TAGS, comma-separated with trimming and empty items dropped). Added `Merge(base, override Config)` which replaces each non-zero override field and copies the override Tags slice (non-nil even if empty), never mutating its arguments. Reworked `Load` to collect all invalid env values into a single error via errors.Join, returning the zero Config on any error while keeping existing per-field validation. Added tests covering defaults, new fields, multi-error collection, Merge semantics, and slice independence; `go test ./... -count=1` and `go vet` pass.
